findings.name: Paid full8 initial baseline with explicit owner
findings.contract: Common full8 final/initial objective ratios require a paid full8 evaluation of the exact common initial native-m bytes, using exactly the same8-frequency observations/geometry/source weights. Existing probe scalars, LU or fields cannot be supplied free. A joint8 arm may retain its own genuine paid initial full8 receipt/scalar; low4-starting continuation and original4 need a separate paid full8 baseline owner. This bookkeeping difference must be disclosed and charged, not removed with borrowed factors. A queried baseline owner is not a fresh unqueried stage2 policy owner; transfer only model bytes across stage owners.
findings.final_evaluation: Final common full8 evaluation and its validation/hash/strict-metadata work occur before actual wrapper return. Reuse an authentic current full8 receipt within its own stage where valid; original4 needs a paid full8 owner. If initial and final models coincide, any cache reuse still invokes the public contract checks and is retained in counters. Stage-local initial objectives or relative targets do not stand in for the full8 initial baseline.

findings.name: Global clock age is not additive local duration
findings.contract: Anchored clocks make every ledger elapsed/setup/checkpoint timestamp an age since the single real global start, including previous preparation/stages. Stage2 setup_seconds may therefore contain stage1 time; summing it with stage1 elapsed double charges wall time. Report absolute stamps and local differences separately. The primary total remains caller-observed final-return minus real global-start, including all stage finishes, transitions, common-objective work and final tail. Prefix seconds are never manually added again. Distinct owner counters may be summed once by owner identity, but nested cumulative snapshots are subsets rather than additional work.

required_future_checks: Bind common initial model/data/survey hashes to paid receipt owner and retain baseline/full8 endpoint cost provenance.

Manufactured controller must detect reset-clock and double-summed-age mistakes, late final objective/metadata return, foreign receipt or warmed-owner substitution, and all incomplete stage/failure denominators.
